title: Lima anggota polis cedera serangan bom di Yala
summary: YALA (THAILAND): Lima anggota polis cedera selepas sekumpulan penyerang tidak dikenali membaling dua bom buatan sendiri (IED) ke arah berek kediaman dan pos kawalan keselamatan di Kampung 3, Mukim Bannang Sata, semalam. Kejadian pada pukul 6.40 petang itu berlaku semasa anggota polis sedang berehat

title_en: Five policemen injured in bomb attack in Yala
summary_en: Yala (THAILAND): Five policemen were injured after a group of unknown assailants threw two homemade bombs (IEDs) at a residential barracks and security guard post in Kampung 3, Mukim Bannang Sata, yesterday. The incident at 6.40 pm occurred while the policemen were resting
